progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ek4 and dwells most on D in Bakhtiyari. The line peaks at Bk4 (457.3 Hz) at 0:13.5. It closes on Ek4, not the tonic (C4 → A4 → Bk4 → G4 → A3 → Ek4).
